purpose: Draw material and portal assets; final map geometry is assembled from exact integer tile data.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game environment MATERIAL SWATCH ATLAS for a precisely assembled square-grid 2D tactical dungeon map.
The attached dungeon is a rendering/material style reference only. Do NOT draw a complete map.
Make ONE opaque atlas of EXACTLY 3 columns x 4 rows, twelve equal square texture swatches, edge-to-edge, no gutters, no text or frames. Overall portrait aspect ratio 3:4. Each cell is a flat full-bleed seamless material texture viewed straight-on. Do not draw tile boundaries, cubes, perspective, platforms, stairs, objects or portals inside the swatches. The game engine will supply exact tile geometry later.
Columns are themes: column1 slate stone prison; column2 pale stone flooded temple; column3 charcoal basalt lava dungeon.
Row1 GROUND TOP SURFACE: broad quiet matte stone with restrained soft mottling, slate gray / pale cool blue-gray / dark charcoal gray. No grout lines, no debris, no tiny cracks.
Row2 ELEVATED PLATFORM TOP SURFACE: the same theme stones in a slightly lighter clean shade, broad calm planes without baked edges or joints.
Row3 VERTICAL BLOCK FACE: darker versions of those stones, gently shaded vertical masonry, few broad stones, no fine details, still flat texture swatches.
Row4 BLOCKED TERRAIN: column1 dark plain near-black stone wall-cap texture; column2 calm deep teal water with restrained broad reflections; column3 black basalt with broad sparse glowing orange lava fissures. The water and lava must remain inside their own exact square swatch, never bleed into adjoining swatches.
Style matches clean mature non-pixel anime tactical environments: soft painted 3D material shading, low detail, crisp not blurry. Keep each material visually distinct but uncluttered. No photorealism, glossy plastic, pixel art, UI, characters, text, labels, numbers, symbols, arrows, logos or watermark. This is a material atlas, not an illustrated scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent RPG map object sprite atlas.
The attached dungeon is a style reference for its physical medieval stone arch portals and warm wall torches. Do NOT draw a map.
Draw ONE genuinely transparent RGBA sprite strip with EXACTLY 3 equal square cells in ONE row (aspect ratio 3:1). No text or visible grid. Each object is isolated and fully inside its own cell, with generous identical transparent padding.
Cell1: one complete squat gray-stone physical ENEMY ENTRY archway with a dark red interior and a restrained RED magical glow. Simple broad stone blocks and a few warm amber wall lights.
Cell2: one complete matching gray-stone DEFENSE GOAL archway with a BLUE magical crystal/rune standing inside and restrained blue light. Same size, perspective, ground baseline and material as cell1.
Cell3: one small medieval wall torch on a simple dark metal bracket, warm orange flame, no wall behind it.
The two doors must match the reference's high tactical-camera view: front of arch visible, slightly visible upper stone planes, no extreme perspective, no long ground platform. The door is a complete self-contained map marker that will fit within one grid cell, so keep it compact and clearly readable. No ground tile or surrounding terrain. Keep shadows minimal and contained.
Simple non-pixel anime-fantasy environment rendering, soft stone shading, clean outlines, low ornament, no extra arches, no labels, letters, coordinate marks, UI frames, checkerboard, white background, characters, monsters, logos or watermark. Transparent everywhere outside the actual painted objects.
